name: Harding Icefield Trail
why: From the forest beside Exit Glacier up through meadows to the edge of the Harding Icefield, an ice plain of 1,800 km² with only nunataks sticking out.
book: No permit, no fee. Exit Glacier road from Seward, 20 km.
water: Streams on the way; filter. Carry 2 litres.
dangers: Snow on the upper trail until July; avalanches in early summer.
Black and brown bears: carry bear spray and make noise.
Never walk on the icefield or under the glacier.
